scan.title: AI Crop Disease Scanner
scan.subtitle: Take or upload a photo of the affected crop leaf or fruit.
scan.pickHint: For the best result, photograph one affected leaf close up in daylight.
scan.tip1: • Fill the frame with the diseased part (leaf, stem, fruit).
scan.tip2: • Use daylight, avoid shadows and blur.
scan.reviewTitle: Result uncertain — please retake the photo
scan.healthyNote: The crop looks healthy in this photo. Keep monitoring and re-scan if you notice changes.
scan.productsNote: Matched from real, in-stock products in our database for your convenience.
scan.noProducts: No matching product is currently available in our store for this condition.
scan.safetyNote: Always read the product label for dosage and safety instructions, or confirm with a qualified agriculture expert before use.
scan.disclaimer: AI results may be inaccurate. Consult a certified agriculture expert for serious crop diseases.
scan.needsReviewToast: Photo was unclear — please retake it
scan.fileTypeError: Only JPG, PNG or WebP images are allowed
scan.fileSizeError: Image must be smaller than 5 MB

chat.title: Chat with AI
chat.subtitle: Ask any farming question in your language.
chat.welcomeDesc: Ask me about crops, diseases, soil, seeds, farm costs, mandi selling or schemes. I reply in the language you write in — Hindi or English.
chat.ex1: Why are my crop's leaves turning yellow?
chat.ex2: Which disease can affect my wheat crop?
chat.ex3: How do I take care of my tomato crop?
chat.ex4: How can I improve my soil quality?
chat.ex5: How do I reduce the cost of growing my crop?
chat.ex6: What should I check before selling my crop at the mandi?
chat.clearConfirm: This will delete the current conversation. Continue?
chat.disclaimer: AI answers can be wrong. For serious decisions, consult a certified agriculture expert.
